themes.evidence: We create world-changing technology that improves the life of every person on the planet.
Inspired by Moore’s Law, we continuously work to advance the design and manufacturing of semiconductors to help address our customers’ greatest challenges.

We're committed to co-engineering and jointly designing, building, and validating new products with software industry leaders to accelerate mutual technology advancements and help new software and hardware work seamlessly together.

Intel’s longstanding commitment to corporate responsibility and sustainability—built on a strong foundation of transparency, governance, and ethics—is deeply integrated throughout all aspects of our business.

linguistic_shift: More emphasis on the company's purpose and values, and a stronger focus on sustainability and innovation.
